main_category.description: The coin's main category: its strongest top-level theme from categories[] (animal, celebrity, ...). derivative is the relation to another coin, not a theme: it stays in categories[] and copy_of/lineage, and is the main category only when the coin has no theme at all. null when categories[] is empty (since rules 0.20.0)

error.description: Why the item has no analysis: the CA is invalid; status 'failed' with 'quota_exceeded' / 'overloaded' when that item was rejected (others still queue); status 'failed' with 'token_not_found' / 'not_a_token_mint' / 'not_pumpfun' when its analysis failed for good recently; or status 'failed' with the analyzer's error when its job failed
error.title: Error

retry_after_s.description: For a rejected item: seconds to wait before retrying it
retry_after_s.title: Retry After S

callback_url.description: Optional https URL that receives a signed JobResponse per finished job
callback_url.title: Callback Url

cas.description: CAs to prefetch. Use `items` instead to pass hints; both may be combined (at most 50 in total, at least one)
cas.title: Cas

inputs.description: The independent inputs that agree on this label, strongest first: name, symbol, description, image, x, trend, db, copy_of. A ticker that spells the name counts as the name. More agreeing inputs make the label more trustworthy
inputs.title: Inputs

label.description: A taxonomy label from GET /v1/meta: a top-level theme (crypto_native) or a sub-label (crypto_native/person). A sub-label also lifts its parent, except crypto_native/paired_ecosystem. crypto_native's sub-labels say what kind of crypto thing the coin is about: slang, person, chain_or_coin, company, trading, tech, launchpad, pumpfun_meta, cto, utility_claim, paired_ecosystem. New labels are added over time
label.title: Label

wave_1h.description: Coins TokenSage analysed in the last hour that carry this label (top-level document categories only; coins TokenSage has analysed only)
wave_1h.title: Wave 1H

created_at.description: When the copied token launched (when known)
created_at.title: Created At

image_distance.description: pHash Hamming distance between the two logos, when they were compared

match.description: Which of this coin's inputs match the copied coin

original_age_s.description: Seconds from the copied coin's launch to this coin's
original_age_s.title: Original Age S

original_market.description: The copied coin's bonding curve at the time of this read

rank.description: This token's place by launch time among the coins with this name or ticker launched within rank_window_hours of it (1 = the earliest); set on the recent same-name copy

rank_of.description: How many coins with this name or ticker launched within rank_window_hours of it, this one included ("3rd of 41")
rank_of.title: Rank Of

recent.description: True: it launched within the copycat window (30 d) before this token, so this is a copy of a live coin (flag copycat). False: an established coin this one builds on (flag references_known_coin)
recent.title: Recent

CreatorFee.description: Where the coin's creator fee goes (rules 0.19.0; all depths).

admin.description: Fee sharing: the wallet that controls the split (market.creator)
admin.title: Admin

creator_fee_bps.description: A custom creator fee rate set at creation (custom pairs only); 0 or null means pump.fun's standard schedule
creator_fee_bps.title: Creator Fee Bps

destination.description: creator: the creator wallet; wallet: one other wallet; split: several recipients with no single dominant kind; holder_rewards: set aside for holders, paid out by pump.fun; charity: a donate.gg charity holds at least half; github: a GitHub-linked account holds at least half; social: an X- or pump.fun-linked account holds at least half; other: a single recipient that is an account of some other program; cashback: back to traders (deprecated coin type); unknown: could not be determined. New values may be added

mechanism.description: direct: the fee accrues to the wallet in the bonding curve's creator field; sharing_config: the curve points at a Pump Fees SharingConfig whose shareholders are paid; holder_rewards / cashback: the coin types

mutable.description: Fee sharing: true when the admin can still change the split (admin not revoked); false once it is final

shares.description: Share of the fee per recipient kind, e.g. {charity: 0.99, creator: 0.01}

summary.description: One plain sentence, e.g. 'creator fees go to charity: 100% to a charity via donate.gg'
summary.title: Summary

CreatorFee.title: CreatorFee

where.description: Which input it came from: name, symbol, description, image, x, trend, chain, db
where.title: Where

FeeRecipient.description: One shareholder of a fee-sharing config (rules 0.19.0).

address.description: The shareholder address as stored on-chain: a wallet, or a Pump Fees PDA for a GitHub/social or charity recipient

charity_config_id.description: For a charity recipient: the donate.gg config id the fee is escrowed for

github_login.description: For a GitHub recipient: the login looked up from the id (when the lookup is enabled and succeeded)
github_login.title: Github Login

kind.description: creator: the wallet that controls the split (the launch wallet, or a community-takeover admin); wallet: any other plain wallet; github / x / pump: a social-fee PDA claimable by that linked account (platform 2 = GitHub); charity: a donate.gg donation PDA; program: an account of some other program; unresolved: not classified (RPC failure)

lifetime_received.description: For a social recipient: what that account has claimed so far across all its coins, in SOL; for a charity recipient: what this coin has donated so far, in its quote token

platform.description: For a social recipient: github, x or pump

share.description: Its share of the creator fee (share_bps / 10000)

user_id.description: For a social recipient: the platform's user id (GitHub: the numeric account id)

FeeRecipient.title: FeeRecipient

per_day_now.description: Credits per day at the last 24 hours' pace
per_day_now.title: Per Day Now

key.description: The raw API key. Shown only once; store it now.
key.title: Key

Lineage.description: Which copy this is, and of what: the strongest copy relation in one place.

kind.description: original: no earlier coin with its name, ticker or logo in the copycat window. early_copy: rank <= 3 and the original launched less than 6 h earlier. late_copy: rank > 10, or the original launched more than 24 h earlier. copy: any other copy. reference: builds on an established coin (copy_of recent false). unknown: no launch time

logo_first_seen_at.description: Launch time of the first coin TokenSage saw with this logo (any near-duplicate), within the logo scan window (7 d)

logo_reuse_24h.description: Other coins whose logo is a near-duplicate of this one's, launched in the 24 h up to this coin's launch

siblings_1h.description: Coins with the same name, ticker or a near-identical logo launched in the hour up to this coin's launch, this one included
siblings_1h.title: Siblings 1H

Lineage.title: Lineage

creator.description: The creator wallet. Since rules 0.19.0 never a PDA: on a fee-shared coin it is the sharing config's admin; on a holder-rewards coin it is the launch wallet when a source gave it, else null. The raw on-chain value is creator_onchain

creator_fee.description: Where the creator fee goes (since rules 0.19.0); null for a non-pump.fun mint or a coin analysed from hints before it is visible on-chain

creator_onchain.description: The bonding curve's creator field as stored: a wallet, a fee-sharing config PDA or the holder-rewards PDA (see creator_kind)
creator_onchain.title: Creator Onchain

pair.description: The token the coin trades against (from quote_mint)

Pair.description:

meaning; any other token feeds the analysis (category crypto_native/paired_ecosystem,

kind.title: Kind

referent.description: What the pair token itself refers to, when known

underlying.description: For a tokenized stock: the stock ticker (TSLA for TSLAx)

generic.description: Only the kind is known: the name, ticker, image or description make it plain what sort of coin this is, but no specific entity was identified
generic.title: Generic

kind.description: famous_animal, meme, person, coin, event, concept, place, other; since rules 0.17.0 also animal (an animal, not a specific famous one), media (a film, game, show or franchise), project (a crypto or AI product, protocol or launchpad), object (food, an object, an abstract thing) and organization (a company, exchange or listed stock)

label.description: What the coin refers to; when `generic` is true, a generic word for its kind ("frog", "crypto project") rather than a specific entity

supported_by.description: The independent inputs that point at this referent (name, symbol, description, image, x, trend, db, copy_of), strongest first for a generic one. A ticker that spells the name counts as the name. copy_of = inherited from the coin this one copies
supported_by.title: Supported By

wave.description: Launch counts on this referent, by TokenSage's normalised referent (coins TokenSage has analysed only)

ReferentWave.description: How many coins TokenSage resolved to the same referent around now ("narrative heat").

first_seen_at.description: Launch time of the first coin with this referent in the last 7 days

launches_1h.description: Coins TokenSage resolved to this referent that launched in the last hour (this one included when it launched in that window)

ReferentWave.title: ReferentWave

as_of.description: The newest data the source gave (Wikipedia: its UTC day)

get.description:
Solana RPC (Helius) calls and credits: this hour, today, the last 24 h, the billing
cycle so far and its projection against the plan; per method; hourly and daily series.
Credits are counted from each method's Helius price (HELIUS_CREDIT_COSTS overrides).

post.description:
Enqueue a failed job again (same kind, mint, depth and hints). Returns the new job,
or the already-open one for the same token and depth.

get.description: Every consumer key (env and managed) with its limits and today's usage.

post.description:
Create a consumer key. Limits default to the service defaults. The raw key is in the
response and is never shown again. Names are never reused, even after a revoke, so
usage history stays attributable.

delete.description: Revoke a managed key. It stops working at once; its usage history is kept.

patch.description:
Change a managed key's limits. Takes effect on the key's next request, with a full
rate bucket.

post.description:
Replace a managed key's secret. The old key stops working at once; limits and usage
carry over. Callbacks for jobs enqueued before the rotation stay signed with the old
key's digest.

get.description:
Job timing by depth (queue wait, processing and total, p50/p95), counts by kind,
failures by error code, hourly throughput and who asked, over `hours`. Jobs are kept
for 7 days.
How often the engine resolved what a coin refers to, per depth, over `hours`.

schema.title: Response Get Recall Admin V1 Recall Get

get.description:
What the engine's inputs look like: each trend source's status as recent full reads
saw it, how fresh the knowledge tables are, paid X spend against its cap, and analyses
per depth with how many found a referent.

Queue depth, upstream source health, today's usage per key and the last day's
referent recall.

Every upstream's calls, errors, 429s and latency over `hours`, its circuit breaker,
and an hourly series. Hosts nothing names (metadata URIs) count as `other`.
Daily request, full-depth and refresh counts per key (UTC days, newest first).
